title: Integrated Autonomous Handoff
elementary_path: Finite products, predicates, relations, hypergraph running-intersection gluing, invariant-set reachability, and exact rationals suffice for the first landing.
principal_formal_risk: The full C-package may be encoded as a conjunction that merely assumes the desired integrated result; the first theorem must expose clause ownership, overlap compatibility, hard gates, and withdrawal rather than hide them in a package predicate.
kill_condition: No nontrivial finite target satisfies the independently stated clause, gluing, target-ownership, and withdrawal gates, or every proposed package predicate is conclusion-equivalent.
nonclaim: A passed structural package and autonomy audit do not establish source lineage, consciousness, personal survival, or numerical identity.

title: Causal-Overlap Process Lineage
elementary_path: A finite time-indexed support sequence, event DAG, nonredundant mixed-support update predicate, and relational composition suffice; no topology or category theory is needed initially.
principal_formal_risk: The process signature or mixed-step predicate may encode the word continuation by fiat, or may be so weak that any causal data copy passes.
kill_condition: Every noncircular finite overlap predicate either collapses to endpoint similarity, admits detached snapshot copies, or fails composition on its intended positive controls.
nonclaim: A causal-overlap lineage relation is a structural criterion choice and does not prove that biological continuity is necessary or that the relation is personal identity.

title: Relation-Valued Predictive Ancestry
elementary_path: Finite histories, operational provenance graphs, monotone closure on a finite relation lattice, partition refinement, and exact branch/fusion rules suffice.
principal_formal_risk: The seed relation can become a disguised ancestry oracle, or the closure can be permissive enough to include independently constructed twins.
kill_condition: No operationally defined seed-and-closure law separates source-derived destructive reconstruction from an independently constructed structural twin without using a conclusion-equivalent primitive.
nonclaim: Relation-valued predictive ancestry does not select a unique continuer and does not establish target realization, autonomy, consciousness, or numerical identity.
